content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-123. - Prohibited.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any owner, agent, tenant, or occupant of any structure, premises,
               lot, or real property to create, maintain or allow any nuisance thereon, or to remain
               thereon.
(
Ord. No. 4095, § 2, 11-19-2007
)
